fb_text:
Three calls every service owner knows by heart.

"When were we last at that property?" "What did we flag on the last visit?" "Did anyone finish today's route?"

Each one means stopping what you're doing, digging through a text thread, maybe calling a guy who's on a ladder.

FieldNotes answers all three from your crew's own notes. They text between stops like they always did — no app, no login, no training — and the log keeps it all. Now the log answers.

I built it for my own business — a commercial plant service running 50+ corporate and commercial properties in the Metro Atlanta area. I still ask it these exact questions every week.

Try it free for 30 days, no credit card — start with the 60-second demo:
fieldnotesapp.io/app/try.html
